title: The first app on the evidence vault
changes: Overview: what the vault holds right now, claims by status, captures by hour, what needs another agent's time (blocked sources, disputed and unverified claims), the latest captures, who wrote what.

Sources: every source with search and filters (kind, status, primary, agent), as cards with the first screenshot or as a dense table; a detail panel per source with its notes, every capture, the claims and events that cite it, its files and each capture's provenance hashes.
Evidence wall: every screenshot in the vault in capture order, with a viewer that steps through them and opens the full-resolution original.
Claims: the per-agent claims files merged, filterable by status, topic and agent, each with its sources one click away.
Timeline: the per-agent timeline files merged and ordered, by phase and confidence, with dates shown exactly as recorded.
Desk: the editor's memos, the agents' notes and the vault's protocol, rendered.
Reads sources/index.json, claims/ and timeline/ live through the bridge; a snapshot inlined at build time is the fallback outside the vault.
Derived images only: screenshots are reduced into app/shots/; the captures themselves are never touched.
